coordinate_note: Coordinate collisions can be intentional island proxies and are not automatically duplicate facilities.

method.csv_row_number: Header is row 1; first data record is row 2

geography_input.attribution: OneMap Geomatics Department, Ministry of Infrastructure, Housing and Urban Development; https://readme.onemap.mv/pdf/Data%20Usage%20License.pdf
geography_input.note: Existing public reference read only; no FollowMe GPS or pipeline outputs included. Polygons downloaded 2026-10-24; not a confirmed August 2025 shoreline.

limitations: Current feature checks do not establish August 2025 availability.
Generic government URLs were inspected in a browser but individual clinic entries, services, ownership and opening hours were not independently confirmed.
CSV VERIFIED/CORRECTED labels are original supplier assertions, not this review outcome.
method.name_normalization: ASCII diacritic folding and punctuation removal; explicit input-name aliases Villimale→Vilingili and Himmafushi→Hinmafushi; no nearest-island assignment
method.polygon_distance_note: Diagnostic threshold only, not a legal territorial boundary.
method.source_checks: Current public OSM API, exact cited node/way IDs; cached response bytes and HTTP receipts in review_sources/
method.source_geometry_distance: WGS84 great-circle minimum to returned OSM node/way vertices, not a full polygon distance. A 1000 m diagnostic threshold identifies obvious source mismatches and is not an accuracy guarantee.
